summary:
Two items this turn, merged into one file (the successor experiment's measured interpretation plus a fresh A2 source result), validated as valid:true.

1. Snapshot question closed with the control. The successor execution completed (receipt c388285f090c4c1c85547bd6ddd9cd98, exit 0) and both comparisons hold: index 0 recovery_state shows the snapshot index advancing 62→202 while the log store last index stayed 62; index 3 recovered_window_end reports applied_delta 0 with 13 distinct snapshot IDs, snapshot_created_without_new_entries true and newest index still 202; index 4 control_window_end for the leader of the same cluster and window reports should_snapshot false, log store index equal to snapshot index, 1 distinct snapshot ID and the same index 202. The interpretation is recorded against that receipt with joint_history explaining that it and the predecessor dd59f37872d240548eff168eb821901f (15 distinct IDs) describe the same scenario and differ only in event naming, which is why only the predecessor's control was unknown. The observed state is also promoted as a fact with executions on both receipts and explicit conditions. Severity stays resource-shaped: repeated full-state snapshot work and IO on an idle recovered node, no safety or availability failure claimed.

2. New A2 result (source-only, negative): an outstanding VerifyLeader future at leadership loss is completed exactly once. The step-down cleanup responds ErrLeadershipLost to the futures still in the leader's own notify set (raft.go:511-526), while replication goroutines keep separate notify maps cleared only by notifyAll (replication.go:100-111), so a late wake-up can push the already-answered future back onto the shared buffered verify channel; vote is guarded to fire once (future.go:272-293) and respond is reachable only from the single main run loop, where the earlier response has already set the responded flag (future.go:94-131) and any first-time arrival is rejected as ErrNotLeader (raft.go:181-186). Two concurrent responders would be needed for the suspicion to hold, and the captured revision has none for this future type. Boundary recorded without claiming a defect: a false reply makes the leader step down immediately, and silencing a quorum leaves the request to the caller's own timeout, which was not measured.

Validation of the returned bytes returns valid:true; prior drafts and receipts (including update-stage6.json and update-stage7.json) are left in place untouched.
